Corollary
[simply connected positive pinching]

Source: petersen:page-0451 ↗ cor:pet-ch11-even-dim-positive-pinching 1. ch11:11.4.19For $n\ge 2$ and $\lambda >0$, choose $\varepsilon =\varepsilon (n,\lambda )>0$ such that any closed simply connected Riemannian $n$-manifold $(M,g)$ with $|\sec -\lambda |\le \varepsilon $ is $C^{1,\alpha }$ close to a metric of constant curvature $\lambda $.
